mapper.select: SELECT PP.* FROM ptl_portfolio pp WHERE pp.portfolio_id = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH CASH_INFO_TEMP AS ( select CASH_ID,FINPROD_ID from FIN_CASH_INFO where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 ='01' and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01' and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE ='01'
AND FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
ORDER BY FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT cit.FINPROD_ID cashId, foor.CALC_RULE,foor.OPEN_MODE,foor.OPEN_TYPE, foor.OPEN_CYCLE,foor.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT FROM CASH_INFO_TEMP cit INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE foor ON cit.CASH_ID=FOOR.CASH_ID /**根据开放类型倒序排，若有申赎不同频，则有两条记录，一个open_type为01,一个为02，则优先取赎回的**/ ORDER BY foor.OPEN_TYPE desc

SELECT * FROM ( /**申购开放**/ SELECT FINPROD_ID , OPEN_VDATE FROM FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop WHERE fop.FINPROD_ID LIKE 'F16_%' AND fop.OPEN_TYPE = '01' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop2 WHERE fop2.OPEN_TYPE = '02' AND fop.CASH_ID =fop2.CASH_ID ) /**赎回开放**/ UNION ALL SELECT FINPROD_ID ,OPEN_VDATE FROM FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop WHERE fop.FINPROD_ID LIKE 'F16_%' AND fop.OPEN_TYPE = '02' /**申赎同频**/ UNION ALL SELECT fop.FINPROD_ID , OPEN_VDATE FROM FIN_OPEN_PLAN fop WHERE fop.FINPROD_ID LIKE 'F16_%' AND fop.OPEN_TYPE = '03' )
FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
order by FINPROD_ID,OPEN_VDATE ASC

SELECT tpd.*,tpda.WITH_LOCK_PERIOD FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpd.TRADE_ID =TPDA.TRADE_ID
tpd.TRADE_STATUS ='01' AND nvl(tpd.IS_CANCEL,'N')='N'
and tpd.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and tpd.TRADE_ID in
#{item}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp WHERE tpd.FINPROD_ID =psp.FINPROD_ID AND tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID =psp.PORTFOLIO_ID AND psp.HODING_TYPE ='03' AND psp.AMOUNT >0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp2 WHERE psp2.PORTFOLIO_ID =psp.PORTFOLIO_ID AND psp.FINPROD_ID =psp2.FINPROD_ID AND psp2.HODING_TYPE ='03' AND psp.CDATE <psp2.CDATE ) )
